articles.title: Buried in Meta’s $18B settlement is a legal pass on kids’ data

points: Meta' endorsed data retention in settlement for child age-detection model training.

Age-detection models aim to identify and restrict content for minors.
articles.insight: The inclusion of data retention in Meta's settlement underscores the industry's ongoing struggle to balance user privacy with content regulation.
